divergences.old: alation document schema --example-only printing the bare example with no envelope
divergences.toil: The flag stays; the example comes back as data in the usual envelope, so with the flag data is the example itself, not { schema, example }. Save .data to use it as an --input-file
divergences.why: Every command writes exactly one envelope, so an agent never has to guess which shape stdout holds. The allowed fields are excused only for calls with --example-only (`when`), so plain alation document schema must still return both.

divergences.old: Every Alation request, and the token exchange and validation, following redirects to any host: the TOKEN header on a data request, and the refresh token in the exchange's POST body on a 307 or 308, went wherever Location named (#77 item 1)
divergences.toil: A redirect to another origin (http:// to https:// on the same host included) is refused with an HTTP error naming both hosts, and the fix is to set baseUrl to where Alation really is. Same-origin redirects are followed as before
divergences.why: A server-supplied Location must not carry the user's credential to a host they didn't configure. A change a principle requires, so a port makes it before a live run (CLAUDE.md, Porting).
